# AIInfraWatch

> AI Infrastructure Markets — GPU pricing, availability signals, and cost audits for AI teams.

AIInfraWatch is an independent market intelligence platform tracking GPU instance pricing
and availability across major cloud providers. It helps engineering and finance teams
understand what they should be paying for AI compute, identify overpayment, and decide
what workloads can safely move to cheaper capacity.

## Product

Three surfaces:

1. **Markets** (/) — Live GPU price index. Provider comparison, availability signals,
   observed vs reliable capacity, hyperscaler premium vs specialist clouds.

2. **Cost Audit** (/cost-audit) — Self-serve audit tool. Describe your stack, get a
   market comparison showing what to move, keep, or renegotiate. Instant on-page result;
   optional analyst-reviewed breakdown via email.

3. **Routing Beta** (/load-balancer) — Future product. Automated routing for evals,
   batch inference, fine-tuning, and overflow capacity. Not yet in production.
   Join the beta to get early access.

## Data

### Coverage
16 tracked providers (15 active, 1 partial):
RunPod, AWS, Azure, GCP, CoreWeave, Lambda Labs, Nebius, TensorDock, OCI, Paperspace,
Crusoe, FluidStack, IBM Cloud, GMI Cloud, VoltagePark (active); Vast.ai (partial)

### GPU families indexed
H100, H200, A100, L40S, L40, A10G, A10, A30, A40, B200, MI300 (DC-class only)

### Freshness
GPU prices: updated daily at 00:00 UTC via Vercel cron.
No intra-day or sub-hourly refresh. Do not assume real-time pricing.

### Availability signals
- "Observed" — listing exists in the index; availability unconfirmed
- "Reliable" — availability === "high" as reported by provider API
- Never use an observed-only price as a production routing target

### Hardcoded rates
The following providers use static published rate cards (not live-scraped):
gcp, lambda, oci, paperspace, crusoe, fluidstack, ibm, gmi, voltagepark

### Not available
- Energy grid data: experimental/seed only, not on a refresh schedule
- Latency benchmarks: not currently surfaced in the product
- Live routing: not built yet (beta concept only)

## Public APIs

### GET /api/gpu-prices
GPU listings. Query params: gpu, provider, type (spot|on-demand), limit, format (json|csv).
Updated daily. source field in meta reflects true data state (live|cached|seed).

### GET /api/providers
Market summary — active provider count, cheapest options.

### GET /openapi.json
Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec.
